items.title: Ep25. How can chameleons change colours?
items.desc: In this episode, Lily and Max discover that chameleons do not use magic, paint, or tiny artists. Instead, their skin has special colour cells and tiny crystal-like structures that reflect light in different ways. They learn that chameleons change colour to communicate, stay warm or cool, and sometimes help with hiding.

items.title: Ep24. Why can dragons breathe file but dinosaurs can't?
items.desc: In this episode, Lily and Max explore the difference between imaginary creatures and real animals, discover how dragons are portrayed in cultures around the world, and investigate what a body would actually need to produce fire. Along the way, they meet some amazing real animals with dragon-like abilities and learn how fossils help scientists understand what dinosaurs could and could not do. It is a fiery adventure where science meets mythology and imagination!

items.title: Ep23. How does medicine make us feel better?
items.desc: In this episode of Little Ears, Big Ideas, Lily and Max explore what happens after medicine enters the body. They discover how different medicines can reduce pain, lower fever, fight certain bacteria, calm inflammation and help the body do its healing work.

items.title: Ep22.How does internet connect things?
items.desc: How does the internet send a Pokémon video from a computer far away all the way to your tablet? In this episode, Lily and Max follow the journey through Wi-Fi, routers, servers, cables, packets and even underwater fibre-optic lines. It is a fast, funny adventure through the invisible network connecting our world.

items.title: Ep21. Why do we love sweet things so much?
items.desc: In this sweet and curious episode of Little Ears, Big Ideas, we find out why our brains get so excited about sugary foods. From taste buds and energy signals to “just one more bite” feelings, Lily and Max explore why sweet things can feel so hard to resist and how we can enjoy treats while still looking after our bodies and teeth.
